sql: SELECT fished_date_season, MAX(fished_date_doy) AS max_doy, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 GROUP BY fished_date_season
SELECT cls, COUNT(*) n, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) ang, SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) ypa FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 GROUP BY cls ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT fished_date_season, cls, COUNT(*) n, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) ang, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) ypa
FROM trips WHERE fished_date_doy<=32 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter','multi_day')
GROUP BY fished_date_season, cls ORDER BY fished_date_season, cls
SELECT avail_season, avail_doy, index_id, value FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' ORDER BY avail_season DESC, avail_doy DESC LIMIT 6
